changes: Restore compact inline device and app selection in the VPN setup guide while preserving alternate subscription URLs.
Restore subscription management actions and loading states, including reduced-motion behavior and a fresh status check before reconfiguring expired Classic subscriptions.
Carry the selected Classic configuration into the balance top-up flow and clear query caches when the account changes.
Use the full profile row for Settings when additional functions are absent.

limitations.summary: Classic purchase still requires manual confirmation after balance top-up.
Physical Telegram Mini App and native client coverage is unverified for this release.
External panel app configuration and merchant sandbox checkout/recurring flows were not part of the verified browser scope.
The unused createEmail wrapper is unchanged; current UI uses the supported combined endpoint.
